_about: Your domain vocabulary. This file is the ONLY source of it: the build fails if the graph uses a class or relation declared nowhere here. A class is {definition}; a relation is {domain, range, inverse, definition}. Use A|B for a union. Raise `ontology_version` when a change breaks existing data, then run `oto ontology accept`. Set `strict_domains` to true once every edge respects its declared domain and range.
name: Northwind Fleet

Bus.definition: A vehicle in the Northwind fleet, identified by its fleet number.

Garage.definition: A depot that maintains buses and holds parts stock.

WorkOrder.definition: An authorised job to repair or service one bus at one garage.

IncidentReport.definition: The written review of an incident involving a bus.

PMLevel.definition: A preventive maintenance level (PM-A, PM-B, PM-C): its distance interval and the garages allowed to perform it.

Part.definition: A stocked spare part, identified by its part number.

StockLevel.definition: How many units of one part one garage holds, and when to reorder.

Role.definition: A position with responsibilities under the maintenance policy.

Route.definition: A scheduled bus line, e.g. Route 12.

for_bus.definition: The bus a work order is about.

raised_at.definition: The garage where the work order is carried out.

raised_from.definition: The incident report a work order was opened in response to.

uses_part.definition: A part consumed by the work order.

about_bus.definition: The bus an incident report concerns.

reviewed_by.definition: The role that must review the incident report.

performed_at.definition: A garage allowed to perform this PM level.

approved_by.definition: The role that approves changes to this PM level.

of_part.definition: The part a stock level counts.

operates_on.definition: A route the bus is assigned to run.

stocks.definition: The garage holds a stock count for this part. Derived from stock levels by rule, never asserted.

asOf.definition: When this fact was recorded or observed (transaction time).

validFrom.definition: When the fact became true in the world (valid time).

validTo.definition: When the fact stopped being true. Absent means it still holds.

supersededBy.definition: The newer fact that retired this one.

sourceDoc.definition: Slug of the document that introduced or changed this fact.

fleet_number.definition: The number painted on the bus.

number.definition: The work order number, e.g. WO-2291.

state.definition: Whether the work order is still being worked.

opened_on.definition: When the work order was opened.

interval_km.definition: Distance between two services at this level.

reorder_at.definition: Stock level at or below which the garage reorders.
